decision: Retain isolated, verified single-probe serializer cache simplification for repeated hundred-metric mean gains. Artifact exact-atime failure is reproduced in unchanged baseline and remains unresolved; full-suite pass is not claimed.

build_control.method: Control and prototype uv/maturin production wheels with unchanged Cargo.lock/features/profile; control byte-identical to previous production. Merged runtime serializer region and release-wheel native match measured prototype; only new cfg(test) tests differ in source.

environment.memory: fresh-process Linux RSS, including native allocations

limitations: Hundred-metric mean gains repeat in all five cases; defaults improve 6.80% then 5.93%.
Small-record means change +1.72% then -0.75%; no small-record gain claimed.
Span means worsen 1.73% and 1.75% (~0.28 us/op); this tradeoff is retained explicitly.
Default/backend p99 improve in both; changing/rules tails are mixed and NumPy p99 slightly worsens in both.
No new buffers, wrappers, dependencies, locks, schema or ABI changes.
Full SDK suite has an unresolved baseline artifact metadata failure; do not interpret targeted/wheel/native checks as full-suite success.
